description: This file defines the OrleansGrainStorageSerializer class, which implements serialization and deserialization of grain state data using Orleans Serializer.

classes.name: OrleansGrainStorageSerializer
classes.description: A serializer class for grain storage that uses Orleans Serializer to serialize and deserialize data.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes a value of generic type T into BinaryData using Orleans Serializer.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes BinaryData into a value of generic type T using Orleans Serializer.
